description: Each morning, search for new job postings matching my target roles and preferred locations, score them against my profile, and send a summary.
instructions: Search LinkedIn Jobs for new postings matching roles in profile_knowledge_base/desired_roles.txt
Exclude any role already in logs/applications_log.csv
Summarize the top 5 new matches as a short digest
Do NOT apply to any role — discovery only
notes: Edit desired_roles.txt and desired_locations.txt to control what gets surfaced.
